name: Report Data 8
definition: Specifies the attributes of a report and its content.

Qualifier.name: Qualifier
Qualifier.definition: Additional specific information to ID (Country, Service, etc.)

Sequence.name: Sequence
Sequence.definition: Contains the specific instance of the report (e.g., sequence “2” of the report within a specific time frame).

TotalOccurrences.name: Total Occurrences
TotalOccurrences.definition: Contains the expected total number of occurrences of the report within a specific time frame.

ContinuationIndicator.name: Continuation Indicator
ContinuationIndicator.definition: Indicates that report is not complete.

Format.name: Format
Format.definition: Report format. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
